build_LMTransformer: build a language model transformer with token embeddings, vision model, and output linear layer
create_causal_mask: create a causal attention mask for xformers, sdpa, or flex_attention implementations
build_fsdp_grouping_plan: build an FSDP grouping plan for fully sharded data parallel training of the transformer
tp_parallelize: parallelize the transformer model across tensor parallel workers using ColwiseParallel and RowwiseParallel
get_num_flop_per_token: get the number of FLOPs per token for a transformer given layers, dim, and sequence length
